scenes.voice_zh: 第一项，储备证明。看平台有没有定期公布用户资产和储备的对照。它说明某一时点的情况，不等于零风险。
scenes.voice_en: Check one: proof of reserves. See whether the platform regularly publishes user assets against its reserves. It shows one moment in time, not zero risk.
scenes.title: ① 储备证明
scenes.sub: 定期公布，但不等于零风险

scenes.voice_zh: 第二项，你所在的地方能不能用。各地规则不同，有的地区要求平台持牌。去当地监管机构的网站查名单。
scenes.voice_en: Check two: is it available where you live? Rules differ by region, and some require a licence. Look up the list on your local regulator's website.
scenes.title: ② 所在地可用
scenes.sub: 以当地监管机构名单为准

params.example: 示例：香港证监会公布持牌平台名单

scenes.voice_zh: 第三项，安全记录。搜一下平台名称加"被盗"或"暂停提币"。出过事不一定不能用，关键看它怎么处理。
scenes.voice_en: Check three: security record. Search the platform name with "hack" or "withdrawals paused". A past incident isn't automatically a deal-breaker; how it was handled matters.
scenes.title: ③ 安全记录

scenes.voice_zh: 第四项，费用。看官方费率页上的现货挂单和吃单费率。还要看提币费，不只看交易费。
scenes.voice_en: Check four: fees. Read the maker and taker spot rates on the official fee page. Look at withdrawal fees too, not just trading fees.
scenes.title: ④ 费用

scenes.voice_zh: 第五项，官方域名。只从官网或官方应用商店页面下载 App。搜索广告和私信链接，都可能是仿冒的。
scenes.voice_en: Check five: the official domain. Download the app only from the official site or its official app-store page. Search ads and DM links can be fakes.

page.summary_en: There is no single best exchange, only one you have checked. Before signing up, check five things: whether it publishes proof of reserves, whether it is available where you live, its security history and how incidents were handled, trading and withdrawal fees on official fee pages, and whether you are downloading from the official domain. Proof of reserves only reflects a point in time and does not mean zero risk. NexuAlpha works with multiple exchanges, and each fact on the compare page links to an official source.
checklist_en: I have reviewed the platform's latest proof of reserves
I have checked whether it is available through my local regulator's site
I have searched for past security incidents and how they were handled
I have checked trading and withdrawal fees on the official fee page
I have confirmed the app comes from the official site or official app-store page

quiz_en.q: What can proof of reserves show?
options: A point-in-time comparison of assets and reserves
That the platform can never fail
That you are guaranteed to make money
quiz_en.answer: A point-in-time comparison of assets and reserves
quiz_en.why: Proof of reserves is a snapshot at a specific time. It is useful, but it does not mean zero risk.

quiz_en.q: How should you check whether a platform is compliant where you live?
options: Check the list published by your local regulator
quiz_en.answer: Check the list published by your local regulator
quiz_en.why: Use official regulator lists as the reference, such as a licensed-platform list published by a local authority.

quiz_en.q: What is the safest entry point for downloading an exchange app?
options: The official site or official app-store page
quiz_en.answer: The official site or official app-store page
quiz_en.why: Fake websites and fake apps often spread through search ads and private messages.

faq_en.a: No platform is best for everyone. Check the five items: proof of reserves, local availability, security record, fees, and official domain, then decide based on your needs.

faq_en.q: Does proof of reserves mean an exchange is safe?
faq_en.a: Not necessarily. Proof of reserves shows a point-in-time comparison of assets and liabilities. It is a useful signal, but it cannot remove every risk.

faq_en.q: Does NexuAlpha get paid for recommended platforms?
faq_en.a: We work with OKX, Bitget, Binance, and other platforms. If users sign up through partner links, the exchange pays the commission. That is why each fact links to an official source so you can check it yourself.
